verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no marketplace, app directory, or mechanism for installing third-party, partner-built agent apps into cubic workflows. Custom agents are the team's own review rules. The MCP server exposes cubic to external coding agents rather than hosting partner apps. Connecting ChatGPT or Claude Code subscriptions only supplies models for local reviews. These are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows
